# Original Hello World Battle template

Unchanged source from [TenkaCloudChallenge](https://github.com/susumutomita/TenkaCloudChallenge/blob/c1aaaa967031ad2bcfa78feda0ae00f1ea87b67e/battles/hello-world-battle/template.yaml), commit `c1aaaa967031ad2bcfa78feda0ae00f1ea87b67e`.

- Template SHA-256: `4de530625bd2a3c0b5a5881f511061709c94c9eb6884d8d6fd1037f3d9bc6bc5`.
- Original Apache-2.0 license retained beside the fixture.
- Test-only input, not embedded in the simulator or executed.
